hero.tagline: Art and the table, in places we only open for one night.

voie_diner.label: Join a singular dinner
voie_diner.text: Book your seat at one of the upcoming singular dinners. In a personal capacity — or as a group for your company (same price per person, tailored hospitality arranged with the house in advance).

voie_compose.label: Compose your own event
voie_compose.text: Serge and Fany compose a bespoke event with you: afterwork, product launch, private evening, wedding. Our methodology, in three words: intimacy, surprise, circularity.
